Anna (Support): FYI customer 'AcmeCorp' on Private deployment sees intermittent 502s when requests originate from corp network behind their proxy. They reproduced: curl -> connection reset. Logs on our side: 'tls: handshake failure from 10.0.0.5: unexpected message' and TLS alerts 40/70. Suspect TLS1.3 0-RTT being rejected by their inspection device.

Jamal (SRE): Can you paste the exact error and a tcpdump? Also what proxy vendor/version?

Anna (Support): Vendor: BlueGate v3.2. They sent this openssl test:

```
openssl s_client -connect api.private.acme:443 -servername api.private.acme -tls1_3
---
SSL_connect:SSLv3 read bytes:tls1.3 alert unexpected_message
```

Anna (Support): They also see 'early_data rejected' in the proxy logs.

Kevin (Infra): BlueGate TLS inspector likely doesn't support TLS1.3 early_data (0-RTT) or mangles ClientHello extensions. Two quick workarounds: 1) ask customer to disable 0-RTT on their proxy/inspection, OR 2) force TLS1.2 from our client side for that route. We can also add TLS fallback to 1.2 in our private agent config for that customer.

Lucy (Eng): If we need a short-term fix, we can add a per-customer TLS profile flag (ENV) that disables TLS1.3 0-RTT and prefers TLS1.2 for egress to their host. I'll sketch a patch. Long term we should add ClientHello compatibility heuristics.

Jamal (SRE): Collect a pcap of failed handshake (client->proxy->our host). Use tcpdump on customer's egress (if they can) or ask them to run against our endpoint. Also request the proxy's SSL profile and whether it's doing MITM (cert reissue).

Anna (Support): Repro steps we gave customer:
1) curl -v --tlsv1.3 https://api.private.acme/health
2) openssl s_client -connect api.private.acme:443 -tls1_3 -servername api.private.acme
3) tcpdump -w /tmp/trace.pcap host api.private.acme

They returned trace and proxy SSL profile: inspection=true, allow_early_data=false, cipher_order=server_preference. They said enabling passthrough for that backend removed failures.

Kevin (Infra): That matches. BlueGate when doing TLS inspection will terminate TLS and re-initiate to upstream; if it has early_data disabled it will actively reject ClientHello with early_data. Proposed immediate action: recommend customer set passthrough or allow 1-RTT, and we'll push a config flag to disable early_data on our side for that backend.

Lucy (Eng): I'll open a tiny PR to add 'TLS_LEGACY_BACKEND=true' per-tenant which sets OPENSSL to disable TLS1.3 early data and remove 0-RTT. ETA few hours.

Anna (Support): Customer accepted passthrough change as temporary fix. They're fine waiting for our tenant flag. Marking P2. I'll attach their pcap and proxy logs to the ticket.

deploy-bot: Deployment 2024-06-12T15:02:11Z rolled back on canary due to unrelated perf regression :warning:

Jamal (SRE): Follow-ups: - collect the exact proxy version and patch notes - add allowlist doc for common TLS inspection appliances - confirm there are no billing/latency impacts from forcing TLS1.2

Anna (Support): Thanks everyone, will update ticket and set a follow-up for Lucy when the flag is ready. :thumbsup:
